subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the remaining work defines public RPC/event semantics, state ownership, persistence boundaries, and cross-agent child behavior; those choices need maintainer intent before implementation or PR adoption.

options.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
options.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, stale-run handling, attention persistence, child rollup, authorization, docs, and tests before merging implementation work.

options.title: Allow Narrow Interim Slices
options.body: Permit smaller blocked/stale or Control UI progress improvements while keeping this broader Gateway activity contract open for later.

options.title: Defer Public Activity Surface
options.body: Keep existing `sessions.list`, diagnostics, and `hasActiveRun` signals until maintainers are ready to own a broader public Gateway API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
recommendation.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, stale-run handling, attention persistence, child rollup, authorization, docs, and tests before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee on this canonical activity-contract issue and is the strongest live routing signal for the API/product choice.
